  <Component ID="MobiFlight_External_Control">
  	<UseTemplate Name="ASOBO_GT_Update">
  		<UPDATE_CODE>
        (L:MF_TBM930_LIGHTING_Dimmer_light_Set, number) d 0 > if{ 1 - (>B:LIGHTING_Dimmer_light_Set) 0 (>L:MF_TBM930_LIGHTING_Dimmer_light_Set) }
       		</UPDATE_CODE>
  		<FREQUENCY>1</FREQUENCY>
  	</UseTemplate>
  </Component>

Then use 2 (>L:MF_TBM930_LIGHTING_Dimmer_light_Set) to turn on the dimmer switch.

label: TBM930_BLEED_AIR_OFF
author: Guest
description:
This event only partially works in SU5: it will change the value internally but the switch in the sim will not update to display the current status.

To work around the issue modify the TBM930_Interior.xml file and add the following:

  <Component ID="MobiFlight_External_Control">
  	<UseTemplate Name="ASOBO_GT_Update">
  		<UPDATE_CODE>
            (L:MF_TBM930_PRESSURIZATION_Bleed_Air_Source_Set, Number) s0 0 > if{ l0 1 - (>B:PRESSURIZATION_Bleed_Air_Source_Set) 0 (>L:MF_TBM930_PRESSURIZATION_Bleed_Air_Source_Set) }
      </UPDATE_CODE>
  		<FREQUENCY>1</FREQUENCY>
  	</UseTemplate>
  </Component>

Then use  3 (>L:MF_TBM930_PRESSURIZATION_Bleed_Air_Source_Set)

author: AntennaRex
description:
Indicates which page the ECAM is currently displaying, useful for lighting LEDs on your ECAM control panel. The index starts at 0 for ENG and increases left to right, top to bottom, with STS being 11. The value 12 is indicated when the Cruise page is displayed.
    -1 = none
    0 = ENG
    1 = BLEED
    2 = PRESS
    3 = ELEC
    4 = HYD
    5 = FUEL
    6 = APU
    7 = COND
    8 = DOOR
    9 = WHEEL
    10 = F-CTL
    11 = STS
    12 = CRUISE

label: WT_CJ4_GEN_L_RESET
author: Jaime Leon
description:
THIS EVENT REQUIRES MODIFICATION TO CJ4_Cockpit.xml
Lvar set here triggers event code in xml file with code below:
Code shown is for resetting of both Engine Generators
--------------------------------------------------
	<Component ID="MobiFlight_External_Control">
		<UseTemplate Name="ASOBO_GT_Update">
		<UPDATE_CODE>
		(L:MF_WTCJ4_Alternator_1_Reset,bool) if{ 
			2 (>B:ELECTRICAL_Alternator_1_Set)
			0 (>L:MF_WTCJ4_Alternator_1_Reset,bool) }
		(L:MF_WTCJ4_Alternator_2_Reset,bool) if{ 
			2 (>B:ELECTRICAL_Alternator_2_Set)
			0 (>L:MF_WTCJ4_Alternator_2_Reset,bool) }
		</UPDATE_CODE>
		<FREQUENCY>1</FREQUENCY>
		</UseTemplate>
	</Component>

label: AXIS LEFT BRAKE SET
author: Jaime Leon
description:
Sets the left brake position from an axis controller (e.g. joystick) to the value given as the parameter [0], from -16383 (0 braking) to +16383 (maximum braking). Note that this is on a non-linear scale:

    -16383 = 0%
    -8191 = 8%
    0 = 27%
    +8191 = 53%
    +16383 = 100%

label: AXIS RIGHT BRAKE SET
author: Jaime Leon
description:
Sets the right brake position from an axis controller (e.g. joystick) to the value given as the parameter [0], from -16383 (0 braking) to +16383 (maximum braking). Note that this is on a non-linear scale:

    -16383 = 0%
    -8191 = 8%
    0 = 27%
    +8191 = 53%
    +16383 = 100%

label: GENERAL ENG REVERSE THRUST ENGAGED
author: Jaime Leon
description: This will return 1 (TRUE) if the reverse thruster is engaged, or 0 (FALSE) otherwise.

label: GENERAL ENG HOBBS ELAPSED TIME:index
author: Jaime Leon
description:
This can be used to find the time since the indexed engine (see note) started running. Similar to ElapsedTachometerTime, this records the time the engine has been running, but instead of taking a % of the time based on the Pct/RPM this takes the full time, but only if a threshold RPM/speed is reached. You can set the thresholds using the accumulated_time_hobbs_min_pct_rpm
and accumulated_time_hobbs_min_knots parameters in the [GENERALENGINEDATA] section of the engines.cfg file.

path: Microsoft.Generic.Engines.Output.GENERAL ENG FUEL PUMP SWITCH EX1:index

label: GENERAL ENG FUEL PUMP SWITCH EX1:index
author: Jaime Leon
description: Equivalent to GENERAL ENG FUEL PUMP SWITCH but differentiates between ON and AUTO

label: GENERAL ENG FIRE DETECTED:index
author: Jaime Leon
description: Detects if a fire has been detected in an indexed engine (see note) or not. If 0 (FALSE) no fire has been detected and if 1 (TRUE) then it has.

label: GENERAL ENG COMBUSTION EX1:index
author: Jaime Leon
description: This SimVar is similar to GENERAL ENG COMBUSTION, in that it can also be used to enable or disable engine combustion. However this SimVar will not interfere with the current state of ths simulation. For example, if the aircraft has a turbine engine with auto_ignition enabled or it's a propeller engine with magnetos, then in the subsequent simulation frames this SimVar may be set to 1 (TRUE) again as the engine restarts automatically.

label: ENG ON FIRE:index
author: Jaime Leon
description: The indexed engine on fire state.  Settable

label: BLEED AIR ENGINE:index
author: Jaime Leon
description: Returns whether or not the indexed engine attempts to provide bleed air.

label: BLEED AIR SOURCE CONTROL:index
author: Jaime Leon
description:
The bleed air system source controller for an indexed engine 
Enum:    0 = auto   1 = off   2 = apu   3 = engines

label: TURB ENG IGNITION SWITCH EX1:index
author: Jaime Leon
description:
Position of the the indexed turbine engine Ignition Switch. Similar to TURB_ENG_IGNITION_SWITCH but differentiates between ON and AUTO.
Enum:  0 = OFF   1 = AUTO   2 = ON

label: TURB ENG LOW IDLE:index
author: Jaime Leon
description: Retrieves the low idle N1 value to be reached by the the indexed turboprop engine with throttle in idle position and condition lever in low idle position (condition lever position can be checked or set using the TURB_ENG_CONDITION_LEVER_POSITION SimVar).

label: XPNDR 1 2 DEC
author: Jaime Leon
description: Custom event for encoder to adjust digits 1 and 2 (1000s and 100s) as a group.  See also XPNDR 3 4 DEC/INC.

label: XPNDR 1 2 INC
author: Jaime Leon
description: Custom event for encoder to adjust digits 1 and 2 (1000s and 100s) as a group.  See also XPNDR 3 4 DEC/INC.

code:
(A:TRANSPONDER CODE:1, number) s0 100 div sp2 
l0 100 % -- s1 10 % 9 == if{  l1 2 - } els{  l1 }
0 max 77 min l2 100 * + (>L:mfXPNDR, Number)
(L:mfXPNDR, BCO16) (>K:XPNDR_SET)
label: XPNDR 3 4 DEC
author: Jaime Leon
description: Custom event for encoder to adjust digits 3 and 4 (10s and 1s) as a group.  See also XPNDR 1 2 DEC/INC.

code:
(A:TRANSPONDER CODE:1, number) s0 100 div sp2 
l0 100 % ++ s1 10 % 8 == if{  l1 2 + } els{  l1 }
0 max 77 min l2 100 * + (>L:mfXPNDR, Number)
(L:mfXPNDR, BCO16) (>K:XPNDR_SET)
label: XPNDR 3 4 INC
author: Jaime Leon
description: Custom event for encoder to adjust digits 3 and 4 (10s and 1s) as a group.  See also XPNDR 1 2 DEC/INC.
